title: •Shocking Revelation
caption: •Shocking Revelation (V)
game_text: Unless you have senate majority, if opponent just ▲ or ▼ a character (except with an Effect with “matching” in game text) or just drew a card from Reserve Deck using a character’s game text, they must place 2 other cards from hand on Used Pile (if possible).
lore: “Well, don’t blame me. I’m an interpreter. I’m not supposed to know a power socket from a computer terminal.”

notes: Unique. Printed base is a Used Interrupt; banner USED INTERRUPT. The slip prints ▲ and ▼ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' / 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' (the slip sets 'just▲' tight; typed with a space). Curly double quotes around “matching”, curly apostrophe in character’s. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes and curly apostrophes in don’t / I’m (twice) (wiki straight single quotes). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 read at zoom. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px; it reads 'a senate majority' — the 2006 slip has no 'a').
